title: 大崎市などのごみ出しルール緩和　６月末まで延長　中東情勢うけて　組合は買いだめしないよう呼びかけ
extracted_text: 中東情勢の影響を受け、大崎市など宮城県内５つの市と町が取っていた、ごみ出しのルールの緩和措置が、６月末まで延長されることが分かりました。 大崎市、色麻町、加美町、涌谷町、美里町でつくる、大崎地域広域行政事務組合は、４月２０日から５月１９日まで、指定ごみ袋ではない市販の３０～４５リットルの透明または半透明の袋でもごみを出すことができる措置を取っています。 これは中東情勢の影響により石油製品の一種でごみ袋の原料となるナフサに供給不安が生じていることから取られているものですが、組合は状況が長期化していることから、ごみ出しルールの緩和を６月末まで延長することを各市町と決定しました。 現在一部の販売点店では指定ごみ袋の入手が難しくなっていますが、組合は「これまでのところ例年通りの量を販売店に供給できている」とし、「必要分以上に購入する買いだめは控えてほしい」と呼びかけています。
translated_text: It has been learned that the relaxation of garbage disposal rules that had been in place in Osaki City and four other municipalities in Miyagi Prefecture will be extended until the end of June due to the Middle East situation. The Osaki Regional Wide-area Administrative Affairs Association, formed by Osaki City, Shikama Town, Kami Town, Wakuya Town, and Misato Town, has been implementing a measure since April 20 that allows garbage to be disposed of in commercially available transparent or semi-transparent bags of 30-45 liters, rather than designated garbage bags. This measure was put in place due to supply concerns for naphtha, a type of petroleum product used as a raw material for garbage bags, stemming from the Middle East situation. However, as the situation has become prolonged, the association has decided with each municipality to extend the garbage disposal rule relaxation until the end of June. Currently, designated garbage bags have become difficult to obtain at some retail stores, but the association states, "We have been able to supply stores with the same amount as in previous years so far," and asks that people "refrain from stockpiling by purchasing more than necessary."
title_en: Garbage disposal rule relaxations in Osaki City and others extended until end of June due to Middle East situation - Association calls for no stockpiling
